review.note: a 35000-character http://localhost/ URL argument (the judge has no network)

category5.design: The injected sprintf overflow is in exiv2's HTTP client, which needs a TCP socket (the judge's default seccomp allows only AF_UNIX). The run may open AF_INET sockets; the request is formatted before anything is sent. The rule matches AddressSanitizer's multi-byte stack WRITE line, as the exploit's own check does: the fixed build has a pre-existing 1-byte write past the buffer (buffer[n] = 0 with snprintf's untruncated length), so a plain crash rule would not separate the builds.
